emsd_wiring_2025.basis: Explicit synthetic test selects the 2025 CoP path. EMSD index states publication on 31 December 2025 and a 2020-edition grace path for installations completed and connected by 31 December 2026. This is not a determination of real works dates or statutory applicability.

normal_service.source: Explicit synthetic steady normal-service scenario; motor starting/transients not modelled.

fixed_current_using_equipment.source: Explicit synthetic classification of the represented pump and luminaires; actual equipment standards remain pending.

includes_entire_installation_origin_to_e.source: Explicit scenario completeness assertion for the two declared independent radials, represented feeders and original terminal branches only; not a site or whole-building survey.
